newsitem.title: USA: Bethlehem Steel ends BethShip sales talks.
newsitem.headline: Bethlehem Steel ends BethShip sales talks.

text.p: Bethlehem Steel Corp said on Friday it terminated discussions with Baltimore Shipbuilding and Drydock LLC about the sale of Bethlehem's BethShip Sparrows Point Yard.
Bethlehem said in a news release that it will permanently close the Maryland yard and sell its assets. The yard currently has 100 active employees.

The company said negotiations with Baltimore Shipbuilding were part of a restructuring plan announced last October. Bethlehem said the parties were unable to resolve "several complex and significant issues," which were not specified.
Bethlehem in a separate news release said on Friday that it will sell its BethForge and CENTEC businesses, also as part of the previously announced restructuring.
